verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform overview lists health insurance as an offering, but it is delivered through the SimplyInsured partner. Payroll docs confirm that benefits deductions and contributions flow through regular payrolls, and can be blocked on bonus off-cycle runs. Community users report offering health insurance through Gusto with limited plan customization, plus one plan-termination billing problem; that anecdote is a caveat rather than a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: documented enrollment workflow, explicit mechanics for syncing health-insurance enrollments to payroll deductions, first-party (non-partner) administration detail, and independent corroboration of deduction sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll

citations.quote: They use the same withholding rates, deductions, and contributions as regular payrolls
All benefits and deductions are default blocked and the payroll is default taxed at a fixed withholding rate when the off_cycle_reason is set to Bonus.
